actors.name: Product Manager
actors.description: Defines pricing for products in the catalog

businessGoals.name: Dynamic Pricing
businessGoals.description: Support flexible pricing strategies including discounts

domainConcepts.name: Price
domainConcepts.description: Monetary value assigned to a product

domainConcepts.name: Discount
domainConcepts.description: A reduction applied to the base price

domainConcepts.name: Price List
domainConcepts.description: Collection of prices for products in a specific context

rules.description: Discounted price equals base price minus discount amount, but cannot go below zero
Discount percentage must be between 0 and 100
Price can only be changed for published products
A price list must have at least one price entry

buildingBlocks.name: PriceList
buildingBlocks.description: Aggregate root managing a collection of product prices. Contains PriceEntry entities.

behaviours.name: create
behaviours.description: Creates a new price list with a name

behaviours.name: addEntry
behaviours.description: Adds a price entry for a product

behaviours.name: applyDiscount
behaviours.description: Applies a discount to a specific product entry

behaviours.name: activate
behaviours.description: Activates the price list for use

buildingBlocks.name: PriceListId
buildingBlocks.description: Unique identifier for a price list

buildingBlocks.name: PriceEntry
buildingBlocks.description: A price entry for a specific product within a price list. Identity is the productId.

behaviours.name: effectivePrice
behaviours.description: Calculates the effective price after applying discount

behaviours.name: applyDiscount
behaviours.description: Applies a new discount to this entry

buildingBlocks.name: Money
buildingBlocks.description: Monetary amount with currency. Already exists in the project.

behaviours.name: applyTo
behaviours.description: Applies this discount to a money amount

buildingBlocks.name: PricingService
buildingBlocks.description: Calculates the effective price for a product considering active price lists

behaviours.name: calculatePrice
behaviours.description: Finds the effective price for a product from the active price list

buildingBlocks.name: DiscountApplied
buildingBlocks.description: Emitted when a discount is applied to a price entry

buildingBlocks.name: PriceListActivated
buildingBlocks.description: Emitted when a price list is activated

useCases.name: Apply Discount to Product
useCases.description: Applies a percentage discount to a product in the active price list

scenarios.name: Valid discount applied
scenarios.description: A valid discount is applied to a product
scenarios.given: An active price list with a product entry at base price 100
scenarios.then: Effective price becomes 80 and DiscountApplied event is emitted

scenarios.name: Invalid discount rejected
scenarios.given: A price entry for a product
